instruction: Change the auto-save interval to 2 minutes in LibreOffice Impress

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting auto-save interval to 2 minutes. The evaluator verifies the AutoSaveTimeIntervall property is set to 2 in the configuration file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the LibreOffice configuration file from the correct path (/home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu)
Metric correctly parses XML with proper namespace handling ({http://openoffice.org/2001/registry})
Metric correctly locates the AutoSaveTimeIntervall property under /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document path
Comparison logic is correct: extracts integer value and compares with expected 2 minutes
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction
Good error handling: handles XML parse errors, missing files, and missing properties
Property name 'AutoSaveTimeIntervall' (with double-L) is correct - this is the actual property name in LibreOffice
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a postconfig step to ensure LibreOffice settings are flushed to disk before verification (though LibreOffice typically auto-saves settings immediately)
Could add logging to show the actual value found vs expected for debugging purposes
